narrative.overview: A small handheld-era toy. The page is a quiet gray surface; every piece of interface chrome sits on a plain white (near-black in dark) rounded tray; color is reserved for the four tile hues where the game actually lives.
keyCharacteristics: One neutral surface, one tray color, four tile colors.
Icon plus number beats labels; trays hold one idea each.
Light and dark are full peers, switched by the system theme.
Motion is brief and functional (0.2s fades, small hover scale).

rules.name: The Color Lives In The Grid Rule
rules.body: Saturated color appears only on tiles. Chrome stays neutral.

rules.name: The Shape Backs The Hue Rule
rules.body: Tiles must stay distinguishable without color alone; new tile work should add a shape or glyph cue.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: Scores and headings are bold; do not add intermediate sizes.

rules.name: The Tonal Tray Rule
rules.body: Separation is a surface step, never a drop shadow.

dos: Do put every control on a white / near-black 8px tray over the gray page.
Do keep color to the four tile hues.
Do keep light and dark in parity.
Do favor an icon plus a number over a text label.
Do keep motion at 0.2s fades and small hover scale, and respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't add drop shadows or glows for depth.
Don't introduce a chrome accent color.
Don't rely on hue alone to tell tiles apart in new work.
Don't widen the column past max-w-xl.
